body_markdown:
LOUISVILLE, Colo., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Biodesix, Inc. (Nasdaq: BDSX), a leading diagnostics solutions company, today announced that members of the Biodesix leadership team will present at two upcoming investor conferences:


**UBS Global Healthcare Conference**
Fireside chat and 1x1 meetings
Fireside Chat Date and Time: Tuesday, November 10, 2:45 PM ET
Location: Palm Beach Gardens, FL


**Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference**
1x1 meetings only
Date: Tuesday, November 17
Location: New York, NY


The presentation will be webcast live and available for replay under “News & Events” in the Investors section of Biodesix website at[Biodesix.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=P556p02_6SPZhFwLDB4-e3n2WEA7o4FE0wp1MINLHnmVrrCZmWLTgJR1HWbiITWpucjk966R34igMfpghaX_aA==) .


**About Biodesix:**


Biodesix is a leading diagnostic solutions company, driven to improve clinical care and outcomes for patients. **Biodesix Diagnostic Tests** , including Nodify Lung® Nodule Risk Assessment and IQLung® Cancer Treatment Guidance, support clinical decisions to expedite personalized care and improve outcomes for patients with lung disease. **Biodesix Development Services** enable the world’s leading biopharmaceutical, life sciences, and research institutions with scientific, technological, and operational capabilities that fuel the development of diagnostic tests, tools, and therapeutics. For more information, visit biodesix.com.
